releases.notes: Beta. Install by USB from the Forbes Automotive updater page, not over WiFi: the flash layout changed in 0.39.8, so this erases the gauge. Press Download Backup (Settings > Device) first, then Import Backup after. New since 0.39.7: touch screen support, peak marker on every gauge, Metric (UK) units, simpler sprite reactions, WiFi sleep, Haldex quick settings, faster Scan My Car, many fixes.

This update resets every setting: press Download Backup (Settings > Device) first, then Import Backup after. New: First Boot and Scan My Car find every value the car has and suggest gauges and triggers, and can set the other gauges up the same; every Menu and Tabs item is on the screen's menu, with Navigation, usb2ip, Oil and Triggers screens; Update All Gauges from any gauge; Drag Timer; Simos 18; K-line OBD-II on any make; many fixes.

First public release: 8 gauge pages in 12 styles from CAN, K-line, OBD (wired or Bluetooth / WiFi dongle), adc2can, usb2ip ECUs and UDS / TP2.0 diagnostics with a DID library; daisy chain with gauge-to-gauge updates, triggers, data logger, fault codes and module scan.
